title: fuse-flow workflow
description: A fuse-flow workflow: the ordered steps a workstream goes through, and what closes each one. Start a workstream with `fuse-flow start <slug> --workflow <name>`.

version.description: Version of the workflow file format; 1 is the only version so far. Engine effect: a file with any other value is refused, so a file written for a different format is not misread.

name.description: Human-readable name of the workflow. Engine effect: none; shown by `fuse-flow status` and the viewer.

description.description: What the workflow is for, in a sentence or two. Engine effect: none; shown by the viewer.

steps.description: The steps, in the order fuse-flow runs them. The current step is the first one in the list that is neither COMPLETED nor SKIPPED, so steps run one at a time, in file order.
